captions.linkedin:
Meet rotli, a calm, local-first notes app for the Mac.

Most notes apps keep your writing inside their service. rotli starts from the other end: every note is a plain Markdown file in one folder you choose, so your work opens in any editor and outlasts any app, including this one.

What that looks like day to day:
• Tasks, choices, tables, and diagrams render as you type, and stay plain text on disk.
• Chat answers from your own notes, using a model on your Mac or the AI tools you already use.
• You decide what AI may see: secure notes never reach a remote model, and locked notes can't be edited by any.

Free, no account, and it works offline. On your Mac, or in any browser at rotli.co.

No account — Nothing to sign up for. No analytics, no ads.
Your folder — Notes are plain Markdown you can open anywhere.
Secure notes — Never sent to a remote model. Not even the title.
Locked notes — Every model can read them. None can edit them.
